_README: Named regions of the trait space, for the standing coverage check in verify:traits.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. A repaired correlation is not a populated space. The joint solve
brought every between-archetype correlation within 0.12 of the model, including every
pair involving honesty (A/H 0.050, C/H 0.066, N/H -0.040, O/H 0.120, E/H -0.114), and
the low-honesty half of the space still has a one-sided hole that no correlation can
see. The eleventh archetype was added after exactly this was discovered by accident.
So the regions the design intends to represent are NAMED IN ADVANCE, each with a
status, and a newly empty one fails visibly while a deliberate gap stays recorded as
deliberate.
STATUS values:
occupied              at least one archetype mean satisfies the predicate. Empty = FAIL.
covered-with-caveat   occupied only at the corroborating threshold. Reported, not failed.
known-gap             deliberately empty, with the reason recorded. Occupied = REPORT,
because the taxonomy then needs re-reviewing, not because it is bad.
background-owned      a region the UNCLASSIFIED BACKGROUND properly owns. It must NEVER
have an archetype. Empty is the correct state and filling it
would defeat the purpose of the background.
THRESHOLD is |z| >= 0.5, NON-STRICT, with a corroborating pass at 0.3. Non-strict
matters: `average` sits at extraversion +0.55 and neuroticism +0.50 exactly, so a
strict '>' reports high-E/high-N empty with a nearest-archetype distance of 0.000. Ten
of eleven archetypes have at least one trait within 0.25 of zero, so that flap would
recur. A stricter 1.0 is not usable at all: eleven points cannot occupy 60 two-trait
boxes, and 16 of the 35 gaps it reports are pure strictness artefacts.
OCCUPANCY IS COUNTED, NOT ASSERTED AS A BOOLEAN. Most regions here hold exactly one
archetype, so a booleans-only check would not notice a region going from one occupant
to zero until it already had.
reviewedAgainst NAMES THE ARCHETYPE SET this taxonomy was derived from. If
archetypes.json carries a different version, the check says the taxonomy needs
re-reviewing rather than silently re-evaluating against a set nobody looked at.
TWO KINDS OF GAP, AND THEY HAVE OPPOSITE ANSWERS. Without this distinction the check
eventually reads as a demand to fill every empty region, and the set grows archetypes
for regions that should have none.
the set cannot express a region the design intends to represent
-> author an archetype when the trigger fires.  example: covert-bad-faith
the set has no archetype for a region the BACKGROUND properly owns
-> abstention, never an archetype.              example: ordinary-calm
The second is why classification must support abstention (D-098). A forced
nearest-archetype assignment labels the modal person 'roleModel' at distance 1.61.

regions.describes: Frets about doing right, meticulously fair
regions.note: The region the eleventh archetype was added for. Single-occupancy: any re-solve that moves anxiousScrupulous empties it again, which is why the count is reported rather than a boolean.
Held by enthusiasticNewcomer alone, and it empties at a 0.8 threshold: the four strongly-honest archetypes all sit at C >= -0.28. Honesty and reliability entangle at the top of H.
reserved sits at E -1.21, H +0.38, so it clears the corroborating pass and not the primary one. Pre-recorded as a threshold artefact so it does not fire every run.

regions.describes: Pleasant to everyone and working it
Bad faith that works the room
regions.note: The ONLY low-honesty region with more than one occupant, and both occupants are the whole low-honesty pole.

regions.describes: Calm, organised, self-serving; works the process rather than the room
regions.note: Recorded before this taxonomy existed. Nearest is terseExpert at 0.370, contributed ENTIRELY by honesty: it already satisfies calm and organised. Filling it is a joint re-solve rather than an edit, and pushing terseExpert's H down would make one archetype the sole occupant of four regions at once.
The two-trait parent of cold-systematic. Named separately so the recorded gap is not mistaken for one isolated cell when it is a corner of a band.

regions.describes: Reads everything, contributes little, not in good faith
regions.note: THE FIRST REGION TO FILL if and when a feature consumes actor typing. A covert automated account, a scraper or a lurking bad actor is low-visibility by definition, and the set currently encodes the proposition that bad faith announces itself.

regions.describes: Cuts corners out of fear rather than appetite
regions.note: The exact mirror of anxious-honest, which the eleventh archetype was added to fill. Leaving it empty asserts that anxious members are never manipulative.

regions.describes: Says no in three words and is always right about why
regions.note: Nearest principledContrarian at 0.280, entirely on extraversion. Its contrast with covert-bad-faith is the evidence that the hole is a property of the low-honesty half specifically and not of the low-extraversion half.
A hard gap at 0.648, no mean carrying all three signs. This is the natural shape of a SYSTEM IDENTITY, so it is acceptable only while no system identity is generated.
No honesty content, so low relevance to good-faith classification. Relevant to moderation-path test fixtures rather than to actor typing.

regions.describes: Emotionally stable and unremarkable on everything else: the modal person
regions.note: THE CASE THAT DISTINGUISHES THE TWO KINDS OF GAP. Sign-wise this reads occupied, because four archetypes are low on neuroticism. Geometrically it is the largest hole in the set: the point (0,0,0,0,-1.0,0) is 1.61 from any archetype, because every low-N archetype is also far out on conscientiousness or honesty. The set says calm implies competent. This is NOT an edge case, it is the modal person, and it must NEVER get an archetype: the unclassified background exists to own the unremarkable middle and does own it. Under forced assignment the modal person is labelled roleModel or professionalSupport and the system reads 'calm' as 'exemplary'. With abstention they are unclassified, which is correct.
